kg_child_context_reason: The generated fragments instantiate aes_key_expand_128 and sixteen aes_sbox modules, so child-module context is useful to confirm exact child interfaces, port names, timing expectations, and wiring compatibility during merge.
code_gap_notes: The module frame still needs the top-level port list and port directions/widths from the interface specification.
Fragments declare text_out as a register but the merge must ensure it is also the owned output port and done is driven consistently.
The generated FSM and data commit logic use reset, dcnt, ld_r, load_cycle, final_cycle, and done semantics that need alignment with the specified reset values and state sequencing.
State byte packing and unpacking is flattened in the fragments, so the merge needs the column-major input/output mapping and initial AddRoundKey behavior.
Child instance wiring for aes_key_expand_128 and aes_sbox must match the actual child module interfaces.

The fragments include both kld and mixcolumns_bypass internal controls, but kld is not used for the key expansion instance in the generated instantiation, so merge needs the intended child key-load semantics.
selection_reason: S003 is required because the current module interface block must be included and defines all top-level ports, widths, and directions.
S004 defines the required registers, widths, reset values, state matrix organization, and text_out output register ownership used by the fragments.
S008 defines the FSM states and high-level transition behavior corresponding to the generated aes_state logic.
S009 defines input data mapping into the state matrix and initial round key addition used by the register_commit fragment.
S011 defines round counter initialization/decrement behavior, one-round-per-clock timing, and synchronous update requirements used by the FSM and commit logic.
S012 defines final-round MixColumns bypass, final output organization, and completion signal generation used by the datapath and output commit fragments.
S014 defines the aes_key_expand_128 child interface needed to verify the generated key expansion instance wiring.
S016 defines the aes_sbox child interface needed to verify all sixteen generated S-box instance connections.
